new_results.statement: For a nonzero literal scalar pivot with Schur complement S, s_{k+1}(A)<=s_k(S); hence s3(A)>=1 implies s2(S)>=1.
With ordered disjoint Schur tetrad energy W2>0, ||p_Q||inf <=8 sqrt(2)e^(1/4)|a|^-1/2 W2^-1/8, using random physical bipartition plus the completed E2 half-Riesz theorem.

If W2=0, S=Delta+R rankR<=2, ||Delta||<1/2 and s3(A)>=1, then R is rank2 with s2(R)>1/2; a 2/7 leverage peel either gives ||p_Q||inf<17.448426|a|^-1/2 or localizes a carrier direction to at most six physical coordinates with amplitude >1/sqrt14.

For one literal hub and exact receiver self block D+VMV^T, the augmented Gram determinant is delta^2=dist(c,ran V)^2. Under leverage<=1/2, ||p_Q||inf<=4 sqrt2(|detM|delta^2)^-1/4 and the density is C0. A 3-frame peel leaves at most ten exceptional coordinates or yields the diffuse gate.
